title: Create: Way Beyond
description: A Create: Aeronautics Based Modpack which takes you to space.
body: ## **Create: Way Beyond** the modpack that lets you reach for the stars. [![Create: Way Beyond](https://modfolio.creeperkatze.dev/modrinth/project/create-way-beyond?maxVersions=1&showBorder=false&animations=false)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/create-way-beyond) --- # Overview From a ***crafting table*** to ***flying to space***, in **Create: way beyond** you can explore the *diversity* of the Dimensions and Planets and enjoy the *stunning visuals*. Create: way beyond focuses around Visuals, Quests, Automation and Adventuring, a wild but exiting combination which will make for an immersive experience with mods like: > * Create > * Aeronautics > * Sky Archipelago > * Create: Northstar > * And many more mods focused around world gen, Visuals and more. --- **Credits:** * Most of the pixel artworks are made by [CraftPix](https://craftpix.net/) * Logo and Modpack By [Vanilama](https://vanilama.vercel.app/) * Quests by VoidableMoon & Lionstark * Music Made By [Laudividni](https://open.spotify.com/artist/56469LYr1fIjQHvs1c0Mjp?si=xjpGhk29S6GLQj76tOuxRA) - Join The Discord server: [![dc-badge](https://dcbadge.limes.pink/api/server/BthmfkUkJ4)](https://moonprojects-mc.de/discord)
